svg.title: Invitation: give an expressive title a supporting partner
svg.desc: Only the supporting-text group font-family changes from Pacifico Regular to Jost Regular. The Fraunces headline remains fixed. The supporting group includes brand line, description, date, entry, activities and address, retaining all copy, nominal sizes, weights, baselines, anchors and tracking. Photo bytes/crop, colors, paper and lighting are identical. Fictional invitation; the cooperation judgment is editorial.
